subject: Surge bridge proposal and growth addendum
messages:
From: Alicia Park <apark@skyward.health>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Cc: CloudFinance Billing <billing@cloudfinance.co>
Date: 2026-08-09T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Usage spike — reconciliation & renewal conversation

Hi Markus,

Hope youre well. We just finished running our month-end checks and noticed a significant retroactive spike in inference hours tied to a marketing pilot we ran from MayJuly. The attached export shows ~420k extra inference-hours during that window (we were previously monthly-committed at ~100k).

Were in renewal conversations for a growth commitment later this quarter, and need to reconcile the overage and decide how its reflected in the upcoming renewal. Two asks:

- Can Redwood produce a true-up invoice or a reconciliation proposal for the retroactive usage? Wed like to avoid surprises in our procurement process.
- Separately, were interested in increasing committed capacity (40%+). Would Redwood consider a one-time bridging credit or amortized credit toward the overage if we commit to a larger reserved pool and extend term by 12 months?

Attached: skyward-usage-appendix.csv (export). PO in progress on our side. Can we get a proposed path and an indicative number this week?

Thanks,
Alicia Park
Head of ML Platform
Skyward Health

Attachments: skyward-usage-appendix.csv (CSV, 42KB)
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Date: 2026-08-09T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Usage spike — reconciliation & renewal conversation

Looping you in — Alicia at Skyward flagged a retroactive spike (MayJuly) and is open to committing to a bigger reserved pool in exchange for a one-time credit/amortization. Theyre a strategic renewal (deal D-93821).

Primary asks: can finance/commercial propose a bridge offer that balances one-time recovery with a path to retain them as a committed customer? Key constraints: Alicia needs an indicative number this week for procurement and prefers any credit to be applied to the Aug invoice.

Suggested starter approach (open to edits):
- One-time credit equal to 20% of the measured overage (applied as immediate invoice credit) OR amortize the credit over the first 3 months of the renewed term.
- Addendum: increase committed capacity by 40% from current baseline, 12-month extension from renewal date.
- Option to cap retroactive exposure if they sign the new commit within 10 business days.

Laura/Ben - can you draft a clean external proposal (numbers and legal addendum) that I can send to Alicia? Vanessa, can you confirm any accounting constraints for applying credits to Aug invoice?

Thanks,
Markus
VP, Growth & Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: markus_klein@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Date: 2026-08-10T14:22:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Fwd: Usage spike — reconciliation & renewal conversation

Markus / team,

Draft proposal below. Ive attached a one-page addendum (proposed-addendum.pdf) that legal can fast-track once the customer accepts. High-level numbers:

- Measured overage (MayJuly): 420,000 inference-hours (per Skywards appendix).
- Proposed one-time credit: 20% of the overage value. Using current list rates that equates to $84,000 credit.
- Option A (immediate credit): Apply $84,000 as a credit to the Aug invoice (one-time).
- Option B (amortized): Apply $84,000 as a credit amortized over the first 3 invoices of the renewed term ($28,000/month).
- Commitment incentive: If Skyward signs the 12-month capacity addendum (40% uplift), well tier the unit price for additional committed hours at a 10% discount vs their current committed rate for the first 12 months.
- Cap: If customer signs within 10 business days, Redwood will cap retroactive exposure to the measured amount above (no additional retroactive adjustments).

Next steps:
1) If Markus approves, I will send the addendum and a short summary email to Alicia with both options and a DocuSign link.
2) Finance will confirm how to reflect the credit on Aug invoice (immediate credit vs amortization).

Attachments: proposed-addendum.pdf (1 page)

--
Laura Bennett
Head of Commercial Operations, Redwood Inference
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Park <apark@skyward.health>
Cc: CloudFinance Billing <billing@cloudfinance.co>, laura_bennett@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Date: 2026-08-10T16:00:00-07:00
Subject: Proposal: Surge bridge + growth addendum

Alicia — thanks for the quick flag. We discussed internally and have a concrete proposal that should keep your procurement timeline intact and give you the capacity headroom you asked for. Summary (please reply with preferred option):

1) Retroactive overage reconciliation
- Measured overage (MayJuly): 420,000 inference-hours (we reviewed your appendix).
- Offer: One-time credit equal to 20% of overage value (estimated $84,000). Two options for application:
  • Option A (Immediate): $84,000 applied as a credit to your August invoice.
  • Option B (Amortized): $84,000 amortized over the first 3 invoices of the renewed 12-month term ($28,000/month).

2) Growth addendum (if signed within 10 business days)
- Commit uplift: +40% committed inference-hours vs current baseline.
- Term: 12 months from renewal effective date.
- Pricing: 10% discount on unit pricing for the uplifted committed hours during the 12-month period.
- Cap: Retroactive exposure capped to measured overage if addendum executed within the 10-business-day window.

3) Next steps and deliverables
- Ive attached the proposed addendum (proposed-addendum.pdf) and your usage appendix.
- To proceed: confirm Option A or B and sign the addendum via the DocuSign link below. Well route credit per your choice and confirm invoice adjustments.

DocuSign link: https://docusign.com/link/DSS-93821 (proposal addendum)
Related ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SUP-4821

If you want an alternate amortization schedule or a partial upfront credit + partial amortization, we can run numbers quickly.

Best,
Markus Klein
VP, Growth & Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Attachments: proposed-addendum.pdf, skyward-usage-appendix.csv
